{{Quote|Flanker, eh? Hatchmate, I take it. Where's he at?''"<br />"''Flanker&hellip;he&hellip;he, uh, died on Christophsis, sir.|Mag and Shiv|<ref name="The Clone Wars: Cold Snap" />}}
'''Flanker''' was the nickname of a [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] who served in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Along with his [[hatchmate]], [[Shiv (clone trooper)|Shiv]], he underwent [[Desert/Legends|desert]] training in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]]. Flanker was later [[Death/Legends|killed]] during the [[Battle of Christophsis/Legends|Battle of Christophsis]], but Shiv wrote letters to Flanker even after his death.

==Biography==
[[File:Shiv.png|thumb|right|200px|Shiv, Flanker's hatchmate and friend]]
{{Quote|I know you're not much for letters, Flanker, but writing them relaxes me.|Shiv|<ref name="The Clone Wars: Cold Snap" />}}
Flanker was the nickname<ref name="The Clone Wars: Cold Snap" /> of one of the [[Cloning/Legends|clones]] of the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]].<ref name="clone troopers" /> Flanker was [[Reproduction/Legends|born]] and trained on [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]]<ref name="SWE" /> to fight for the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] in the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="clone troopers" /> In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="ERC" /> Flanker&mdash;along with his [[hatchmate]], [[Shiv (clone trooper)|Shiv]]&mdash;was assigned to [[Desert/Legends|desert]] training. During this [[Time/Legends|time]], Flanker joked that after all their desert training, one of them would end up being deployed to a [[Water/Legends|water]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]].<ref name="The Clone Wars: Cold Snap" />

When [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederate]] forces [[Battle of Christophsis/Legends|attacked]] the<ref name="The Clone Wars: Cold Snap" /> [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]]<ref name="The Essential Atlas">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> planet of [[Christophsis/Legends|Christophsis]], Flanker was one of the [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] whom the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] dispatched to defend the world; however, he was [[Death/Legends|killed]] during the battle. Despite Flanker's death, Shiv relaxed himself during his own missions by writing letters to his hatchmate. Shiv wrote one such letter about problems he and his [[Squad/Legends|squad]] faced while on the ice planet [[Orto Plutonia/Legends|Orto Plutonia]]. During the mission, Shiv talked with his [[Clone Commander/Legends|commander]], [[Mag (clone trooper)|Mag]], about Flanker and his recent death.<ref name="The Clone Wars: Cold Snap" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Remember how you used to joke that after all that desert training, one of us would get shipped to a water planet?|Shiv, in a letter to Flanker|<ref name="The Clone Wars: Cold Snap" />}}
Flanker did not care much for letters, but he had a sense of humor when he joked about his desert training with Shiv, jesting that one of them would get shipped to a water world.<ref name="The Clone Wars: Cold Snap" /> As a clone of Jango Fett,<ref name="clone troopers" /> Flanker was [[Gender/Legends|male]], stood 1.83 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] tall<ref name="SWE" /> and had [[Color/Legends|tan]] skin.<ref name="Skin" />

==Behind the scenes==
Flanker was first mentioned in [[The Clone Wars: Cold Snap|''Cold Snap'']], a tie-in [[Star Wars comic books|webcomic]] for "[[Trespass]]," an episode of the [[The Clone Wars: Season One|first season]] of the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series. ''Cold Snap'' was written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]].<ref name="The Clone Wars: Cold Snap" />
